<tool_result name="file_view">
# Token Request Validation v3

Status: approved (rev 3, 2026-09-30)

## 1. Scope
Applies to POST /v1/tokens request bodies. Nested validation is run after top-level schema checks pass.

## 2. billing.address
- line1: required, 1-120 chars, no leading/trailing whitespace
- postal_code: required when country is US or CA; format per country (US: 5 or 9 digits; CA: A1A 1A1)
- country: required, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, uppercase
- Unknown keys under billing.address are rejected with code INVALID_FIELD.

## 3. card.exp
- Format MM/YY or MM/YYYY.
- Must not be earlier than the current calendar month (UTC).
- Expiry more than 15 years in the future is rejected.

## 4. metadata.*
- Values are strings, max 256 chars.
- Any value that contains a 13-19 digit run (spaces or dashes permitted between digit groups) that passes the Luhn check is rejected with code PAN_IN_METADATA.
- Keys are not inspected.

## 5. Error codes
INVALID_FIELD, PAN_IN_METADATA, EXP_IN_PAST, EXP_TOO_FAR.

## 6. Open questions
- Whether metadata values that fail Luhn but are 13-19 digits should be logged. Deferred to v4.
</tool_result>
